text: Why this university? Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the P.R.China. The university, which is one of the largest in China, is distinctive among institutions of higher education. It covers a set of disciplines: philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, agriculture, science, engineering, medicine and management. Program Introduction The RES programme focuses on a range of economic issues in China. Emphasis is on timely, policy-related research that is of use to decision-makers as well as researchers from the region and beyond. Duration:2 Years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Economics in Quantitative Economics by Huazhong University of Science and Technology. Future Career The graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-trade corporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.
